correctness.rationale: Eight explicit finite GS4^c models, all of size at most three, are checked against the published birelational frame conditions. Exact evaluation gives 35 distinct eight-model fingerprints, and all 595 modality pairs are explicitly separated. A second set-based replay reproduced the certificate. The claim is only a lower bound, so no exhaustive-model inference is used.

value.rationale: The motivating paper centrally studies how many modality equivalence classes survive in non-classical S4 variants. A certified lower bound of 35 turns a qualitative finiteness result with a 105 upper reduction into the nontrivial interval 35..105 and supplies very small reusable separation witnesses. The invariant is intrinsic to the source problem rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
